note: W12-T04 reconciliation of historical Elo ladders and checkpoint genealogy. Verified by docs/internal/core-ip/tools/elo_history.py; see work-orders/evidence/W12-elo-genealogy.md.
numerical_policy: A reproducible history must be recomputed from its digest-pinned inputs by an independent implementation (aggregated pair statistics, plain Python floats) and match every committed leaderboard and snapshot cell, as Python round/repr write them, with one exception: methods that are exchangeable in the Bradley-Terry likelihood (equal match counts against every other method and equal total score) have equal ratings in exact arithmetic, so their relative order may differ; that order was set by floating-point accumulation and is reported, not treated as data. Unrounded historical ratings were never retained.

histories.subject: same-cut v1 deep ladder (jope-same-cut-v1-deep), ten committed test-10 regression datasets
histories.scope: historical same-cut snapshot on a favourable ten-dataset selection; not the current ASM30 panel and not a held-out or transfer result

receipts.original_execution: jope-bench run/ladder and jope-arena elo at 97c4ea1daf7ed67ee34bc538f2b855ecab06a318 (the git_sha of all ten reports, observed 2026-09-23T06:08-06:10Z); commands in assets/same-cut/v1/SOURCES.md
receipts.algorithm: regularized Bradley-Terry on the Elo scale (crates/jope-arena/src/elo.rs::fit_elo, the port of sotarena/elo.py): one equal-weight match per dataset and method pair, outcome 1/0.5/0 with the relative tie rule |a-b| <= 1e-12*max(|a|,|b|,1), start and centre 1500, L2 1e-4, at most 250 synchronous diagonal-Newton iterations, per-iteration clamp +-40, stop when the largest update is below 1e-8, final mean-centring; sorted dataset and method-pair accumulation order

limitations: The scores.csv track was written by jope-bench from the committed reports; the reports themselves are re-derived by committed_evidence.rs, not by this replay.
Ten datasets chosen where the historical engine ranked first; the ladder does not generalise to a broader panel.
Ratings are relative to this method universe and are displayed to 0.1 Elo; unrounded values were never retained.

limitations: The builder is deterministic, but with no retained snapshot there is no history to reconcile.
Parent edges are block-initialization edges: every checkpoint of a block names the state its block started from, so within-block order is not a recorded parent edge.
The block-0 parent (step 3000, 20dca670...) is named by digest but its own record is not in this table; ancestry above it, including steps 1-3000, is not retained here (sections/09.md:182).
Each block names one corpus digest; corpus-to-dataset membership is not retained, so exposure totals are refused and checkpoint exposure to the frozen panel stays unknown (sections/02.md:32).
September 9-11 audit capture: first and last metric rows per block only; every block reset AdamW, so parent edges carry weights but not optimizer continuity.
Corpus-to-dataset membership is not retained; exposure totals are refused.
